scope: Pilot full-body classical tracking baselines, not a proof of controller-class superiority.
contract: All eight normalized actions clipped to [-1,1]; original leg PD 500/10 and wheel 12 Nm action scale; original speed-dependent DC motor torque bounds. No root forces or pose correction after reset.
comparison_notes: TVLQR includes affine reference-dynamics defects; the retarget is not assumed dynamically feasible.
NMPC is bounded sampling-based nonlinear shooting (CEM), not an IPOPT/acados solution or globally optimal solver.
Both classical controllers use simulator full states and reference preview, unlike the frozen actor interface. Preview and compute are explicit advantages/limitations.
Prediction friction stays at 0.7 for all validation cases; no oracle validation-friction retuning.
The cost tracks desired root yaw and velocity; it does not penalize sideslip toward zero.
No real-time deadline enforced in the simulator; report 20 ms budget overruns, not real-time deployability.
